The productive 25-symbol substitution has incidence matrix M primitive because M^20 has all positive entries; its Perron root rho solves rho^3=rho+1. Letter frequencies v solve Mv=rho v. Every internal symbolic ordered pair contributes b_{uv}; each prior boundary pair maps to (last mu(u),first mu(v)), giving a 67-state deterministic Q and exact balance (rho I-Q)w=b. Since spectral radius(Q)=1<rho, w is uniquely determined. Count output 11 internally within eta(q) and across paired boundaries, normalize by mean output length L=1-rho+rho^2. Exact symbolic algebra in inspected verify.py is designed to verify P11=(4+9rho-8rho^2)/7 and output normalization; independent separately reconstructed PF/pair numerical system obtained P11≈0.2690628978898806 and covariance≈-0.0556550593548617, agreeing with formula. Stationarity yields P10=P01=rho^-2-P11 and P00=1-2rho^-2+P11, with rho^-2=1+rho-rho^2. Covariance (11+2rho-8rho^2)/7 is negative since rho>33/25 and its numerator is decreasing for x>1/8 and negative at 33/25.
